title: Social Cohesion through Common Spaces in Residential Estates
what_it_is: Social Cohesion through Common Spaces in Residential Estates

sections.label: Social cohesion and COVID-19 outcomes
sections.summary: Societies with greater social cohesion have had better COVID-19 outcomes and can overcome disasters, terrorism and national crisis.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Societies with greater social cohesion and cohesiveness have been shown to have had better outcomes from COVID-19 and the same can be said with such societies in overcoming disasters, acts of terrorism and bouncing back from national crisis.

sections.label: Common spaces in residential estates
sections.summary: Social cohesion is connectedness and belonging, and the motion focuses on common spaces in residential estates.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It is a deeper sense of connectedness between peoples; a sense of belonging to a collective identity, with an entrenched trust and solidarity towards a common good.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I scoped this Adjournment Motion of Social Cohesion to focus on Common Spaces in Residential Estates, because such common spaces make up the first boundaries of where one's private residence interfaces with common areas of interaction with others in the community.

sections.label: Lively Places Programme funding
sections.summary: As of end-2023, over $1.1 million was disbursed and committed under the Lively Places Programme, supporting 229 projects.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: As of end-2023, we have disbursed and committed more than $1.1 million under the Lively Places Programme, supporting 229 projects that enliven common spaces and strengthen community identity.

sections.label: Estate Upgrading Programme households
sections.summary: Agencies engage residents on upgrading proposals under the Estate Upgrading Programme, benefiting about 54,000 households in 74 estates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Agencies also engage residents to develop upgrading proposals for their estates under the Estate Upgrading Programme, which has benefited about 54,000 households in 74 estates to date.

sections.label: Town Councils manage common spaces
sections.summary: Town Councils manage and maintain common spaces in public housing estates, and residents need permission to use them.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Today, our Town Councils manage and maintain the common spaces in public housing estates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Residents who wish to use the common spaces are required to apply to the Town Councils for permission.
